Use this as scratch paper for R calculations during the Exam.

Each section corresponds to a question on the Exam. Enter and run your R code in the code box. Your results will appear below the box.

Enter your final answer in Hawkes Learning in the exam. This page does ***not*** save or submit your work. Refreshing the page will reset the page and remove your work.

*Similar* functions available:

-   round_half_up(value, digit): rounds numbers to specified digits using classic rounding technique

-   fraction(): presents calculation as a fraction

```{webr-r}
#| context: setup
# Helper functions

# janitor::round_half_up() -----------------------------------------------------
round_half_up <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  multiplier <- 10^digits
  
  sign(x) * floor(abs(x) * multiplier + 0.5) / multiplier
}

# MASS::fractions -----------------------------------------------------
fractions <- function(x, max_denominator = 2000, tolerance = 1e-7) {
  
  convert_fraction <- function(value) {
    
    # Handle missing or non-finite values
    if (is.na(value)) return(NA_character_)
    if (is.infinite(value)) return(as.character(value))
    
    # Handle whole numbers
    if (abs(value - round(value)) < tolerance) {
      return(as.character(round(value)))
    }
    
    # Keep track of negative values
    sign <- ifelse(value < 0, "-", "")
    value <- abs(value)
    
    # Find the closest fraction
    denominators <- 1:max_denominator
    numerators <- round(value * denominators)
    
    errors <- abs(value - numerators / denominators)
    
    best <- which.min(errors)
    
    numerator <- numerators[best]
    denominator <- denominators[best]
    
    # Reduce the fraction
    gcd <- function(a, b) {
      while (b != 0) {
        temp <- b
        b <- a %% b
        a <- temp
      }
      a
    }
    
    divisor <- gcd(numerator, denominator)
    
    numerator <- numerator / divisor
    denominator <- denominator / divisor
    
    paste0(sign, numerator, "/", denominator)
  }
  
  result <- vapply(x, convert_fraction, character(1))
  
  # Preserve dimensions for matrices/arrays
  if (!is.null(dim(x))) {
    dim(result) <- dim(x)
    dimnames(result) <- dimnames(x)
  }
  
  result
}
```
